units.source_text: 紫姬的父亲兵部卿亲王过去几年来并不同情于源氏公子流放之苦，

en.t: In recent years, Lady Murasaki's father, Prince Hyobukyo, had shown no sympathy for Lord Genji's suffering in exile,

units.source_text: 而一味趋炎附势，因此现在源氏内大臣对他不快，

en.t: and had simply followed those in power, so now Genji, the Inner Minister, was displeased with him,

units.source_text: 他对世间一般人普施恩惠，无求不应。

en.t: Genji bestowed favors widely on people in general, and refused almost no request.

units.source_text: 只有对于兵部卿亲王一家漠不关情。

en.t: Only toward Prince Hyobukyo and his household did he remain cold and unconcerned.

units.source_text: 藤壶皇后可怜这哥哥，认为此乃一大憾事。

en.t: Empress Fujitsubo pitied this elder brother of hers and considered the situation a great regret.

units.source_text: 此时天下大权，平分为二，

en.t: At this time, the supreme power of the realm was divided into two equal parts,

units.source_text: 由太政大臣与内大臣翁婿二人协力同心，随意管领。

en.t: and was managed as they pleased by the Grand Minister and the Inner Minister, father-in-law and son-in-law, who worked together with one mind.
